remarks: ***HIGHEST AND BEST DUE BY TUESDAY AT 2;00 P.M***  Stunning 5 Bedroom Westover Colonial with classic elegance and modern comforts gracefully situated on a private level acre with room for a pool! Just minutes to downtown Stamford, Greenwich, Metro North and major highways, this wonderful home should not be missed!
